content.user_title: Hand Off Claude Sessions to Background Agents
content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose momentum when context becomes dense or work changes hands. This skill creates a focused handoff summary and starts a fresh Claude background agent.
actual_capabilities: Writes a handoff summary from the current conversation.
Launches a Claude background agent with the summary as its prompt.
Uses a descriptive name for the background agent.
Adds a suggested skills section for the next agent.
References existing artifacts by path or URL instead of duplicating them.
Instructs the agent to redact sensitive information before handoff.
limitations: Requires the Claude CLI and background agent support.
Does not save a separate handoff document by default.
Handoff quality depends on the available conversation context.
Sensitive data redaction is best effort and should be reviewed.

use_cases.title: Continue Implementation Work
use_cases.description: Create a concise summary so a new background agent can continue coding from the current state.

use_cases.title: Delegate Follow-Up Tasks
use_cases.description: Start a named background agent for a focused next step while the current session remains available.

use_cases.title: Preserve Project Context
use_cases.description: Capture decisions, references, and suggested skills before moving work into a fresh session.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Move the current task to a fresh background agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Hand this conversation off to a fresh background agent. Focus on the current goal, completed work, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Named Task Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a background agent with a clear display name.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff for a background agent named Fix Login Flow. Include the current status and immediate next step.

prompt_templates.title: Artifact-Aware Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Reference existing documents instead of repeating their contents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Hand off this session and reference existing plans, issues, diffs, or commits by path or URL. Avoid duplicating artifact content.

prompt_templates.title: Specialized Agent Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare the next agent with recommended skills and boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an advanced handoff for the next background agent. Include suggested skills, redaction notes, risks, open questions, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Hand off the current bug fix to a new agent.
output_examples.output: A named background agent receives a concise summary with the bug, changed files, current hypothesis, next checks, and suggested skills.

output_examples.input: Continue this refactor in a fresh session.
output_examples.output: The handoff references existing plans and diffs, summarizes completed changes, lists unresolved decisions, and starts a focused background agent.

output_examples.input: Prepare the next agent for release cleanup.
output_examples.output: The result includes release goals, known blockers, validation steps, redaction reminders, and a descriptive background agent name.

best_practices: Give the next session a specific goal before invoking the skill.
Review the summary for secrets and personal data before the agent starts.
Reference durable artifacts by path or URL when they already contain details.
anti_patterns: Do not include API keys, passwords, or personal data in the handoff.
Do not use vague background agent names that hide the task purpose.
Do not duplicate long plans or diffs that already exist elsewhere.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It summarizes the current conversation and starts a fresh Claude background agent with that summary.

faq.question: Does it save a handoff file?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs Claude to launch a background agent instead of saving the summary.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility.

faq.question: How are secrets handled?
faq.answer: The skill tells the agent to redact API keys, passwords, and personal information before creating the handoff prompt.

faq.question: What should I provide as an argument?
faq.answer: Provide the focus of the next session, such as a bug, feature, review, or cleanup task.

faq.question: Who manages the background agent?
faq.answer: The user manages the agent through Claude agent controls after it starts.
